description: The nested half of the conditional chain (workflow spec §2.10): a script measures, a decision holds the measurement to a rule, and a values script reads the measurement by reference. outer.json nests this document as `tail`, so these steps join that run as tail/measure, tail/gate_k and tail/best; a reference inside this document names its own steps and resolves under the sub-root, never to an outer step of the same name. The scripts are the conditional fixtures' two, copied beside this file by the tests.
